review: I like how this looks: each stage has its own colour, the ghost glows, and spikes and lasers are easy to see. First Steps is gentle, but 29 of 100 players still die on its first spike row, which is a lot for a tutorial. Saw Mill comes much too early; only 37% pass and the saws float around with no clear pattern, so deaths feel random to me. Ferry Lines and Crumble Bridge are my favourites, calm and readable. Spring Loaded hides saws high above the springs. Gauntlet mixes everything and even the best player died there, which would make me quit.
best: Ferry Lines is clear, calm and fair, with deaths that are obviously my own missed jumps.
worst: Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3 with drifting saws that kill most players before they learn them.
